name: Art brut
description: Raw, untrained-looking abstract art: graffiti marks, naive patterns and tangled webs of coloured scribbles that fill the whole surface. Purely abstract, no faces or figures.
light: no light source, flat colour on paper or canvas
flat bright colour on raw brown canvas
chalky bright colours on a black ground
soft coloured pencil on white paper, tangled lines in many hues
composition: all-over and crowded, marks, patterns and scribbles packed to the edges
one big knot of raw marks on plain paper with a few loose strokes around it
a horizontal frieze of repeated naive patterns in a row
a web of tangled coloured lines spreading over a pale sheet
camera_or_medium: marker, gouache and oil stick on paper or raw canvas; childlike, confident lines
texture_detail: wobbly hand-drawn lines, scribbled tangles in many colours, visible brush and crayon, paper grain
subjects: a wall of graffiti marks, crowns and arrows as pure pattern
a tangle of coloured pencil lines like a nest
a crowded field of naive dots, zigzags and spirals
thick oil-stick strokes crossing raw canvas
